Yesterday I officially hit my 150th workout using Hevy, and I couldn’t be happier with this app!

Hevy has become such an important part of my fitness journey. It has helped me stay consistent, track my progress, set goals, and actually see how far I’ve come. I love being able to log my workouts, monitor my improvements, and challenge myself to keep getting stronger.

The app is incredibly user-friendly, well organized, and has everything I need to keep myself motivated and accountable. I genuinely look forward to logging my workouts!

If you’re looking for an app to help you stay on track, build consistency, and take your fitness journey seriously, I cannot recommend Hevy enough.

Here’s to 150 workouts and many, many more! Thank you, Hevy, for being part of my journey! ❤️💪

title: 50th workout in the books
body: I had worked out for about a year and a half and while I was making decent progress, I wasn’t where I thought I should be.  My friend Dan suggested keeping a Gym log to track my progress for each individual exercise, rep, and weight.  He keeps a written log.  I know myself well enough to know that I am not going to last long writing in a log, much less going back and analyzing it.  I thought, “there has to be a better way!!” I was just winging it from week to week unsure what weights and reps I had used the prior week and it was not efficient.  I searched for a workout log in the App Store and Hevy was the one that grabbed my eye first.  I knew nothing about them and just wanted to try one out. I liked the ease of use on the app.  I have tracked every single rep since I downloaded it.  That’s when I started making real progress.  Okay, I did 20 reps with 40lbs last week, let’s push it more next week.  The guesswork was gone from it.  It shows you your previous set data from your last workout and when you surpass your previous best it pops up reward showing such.  I make it a goal to set new PRs each month.  Love the app after 50 workouts with it and will continue to use it.

title: Hevy has been a game-changer for my training.
body: The simple logging and clear history make it easy to see exactly where I am on each lift and push just a little further than last time. Seeing those previous numbers right there keeps me honest and motivated — I’ve hit several new personal records on movements that used to stall. Clean interface, solid progress tracking, and it actually helps me lift more. Highly recommend.

title: Go to workout app
body: I love using Hevy to track all my workouts. It works well on my phone but I particularly like that it syncs with my Apple Watch. Very flexible in allowing custom exercises, warmup, and drop sets. One improvement that I’d recommend is to allow tracking distance in meters in addition to miles for a rowing workout.
